method: 35 of 314 universe names checked against company press releases (newswire copies on finviz/investingnews/globeandmail of the company's own Business Wire / GlobeNewswire / ACCESS wire notices) and baselines; the other 279 were not checked and are listed in unchecked_tickers. Mega-caps and BDC/REIT/utility rows were deprioritised as having least room for an unpriced finding. No direction view is expressed anywhere in this file.
